claim_text: The frozen interpretable model showed interval-supported top-decile observed-positive enrichment for Any outer-package affective imagery (lift@10=2.5986622073578598, 95% CI 1.3671521035598706-3.7742393162393157), while its AUROC interval remained wholly below 0.5, indicating poor global ranking discrimination.

The frozen interpretable model showed interval-supported top-decile observed-positive enrichment for General visual appeal (lift@10=3.3205128205128207, 95% CI 1.2029420893571838-4.99514679798357), while its AUROC interval remained wholly below 0.5, indicating poor global ranking discrimination.

The frozen interpretable model showed a top-decile lift point estimate above 1 for Cute/friendly (lift@10=2.9298642533936654, 95% CI 0.7654966392830469-4.9951456310679614), but the interval included 1; enrichment evidence is exploratory, and the AUROC interval remained wholly below 0.5.

The corresponding outcome-level locked-test evidence was E2, with a below-0.5 AUROC global-ordering flag. This is a qualified design hypothesis, not feature-level locked-test validation and not causal evidence.
